pages.title: LEGO Bricks Stacked into a Building Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: A tower built from LEGO bricks rises in this printable coloring page, combining stacked platforms, round studs, and an arched opening near its base. The coloring sheet uses large rectangular faces and simple side panels, with open spaces between the upper supports.

pages.title: LEGO Blank Minifigure Template Coloring Page
pages.description: A blank LEGO minifigure fills this printable coloring page, with a plain rounded head, tapered torso, curved arms, and two block-shaped legs. Its empty face and undecorated body provide room for an original design. The coloring sheet keeps the familiar claw-shaped hands and simple toy joints visible.

pages.title: LEGO House with a Pitched Roof, Windows, and a Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO house stands beside a small garden in this printable coloring page, with a pitched roof, chimney, paneled windows, and a front door. Stepping stones lead toward the entrance, while three large flowers grow from a brick planter. Studs and wall seams divide the coloring sheet into clear sections.

pages.title: LEGO City Police Officer beside a Patrol Car Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO City police officer stands beside a patrol car in this printable coloring page, wearing a peaked cap, badge, and pocketed uniform. The car has a roof light bar, studded hood, broad windshield, and large tires. Simple building outlines frame the two main subjects on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO City Police Helicopter Flying over the City Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO City police helicopter flies above buildings in this printable coloring page, showing its crossed main rotor, tail rotor, landing skids, and cockpit. A helmeted pilot holds the controls behind the curved windshield. Studded panels, large windows, and a few clouds keep the coloring sheet focused on the aircraft.

pages.title: LEGO City Firefighter Using a Hose beside a Fire Truck Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO City firefighter directs a hose in this printable coloring page, standing before a fire truck with a roof ladder and large wheels. Both hands grip the hose as a broad spray leaves its nozzle. The helmet, jacket panels, and connected equipment provide distinct shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO City Construction Worker Operating an Excavator Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO City construction worker operates an excavator in this printable coloring page, sitting behind two control levers beneath the cab's curved roof. The articulated digging arm ends in a toothed bucket, and wide tracks support the vehicle. Loose bricks and small ground marks complete the construction coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Passenger Train Traveling Along Curved Tracks Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO passenger train follows curved tracks in this printable coloring page, with a driver in the front cab and two passengers visible through carriage windows. A coupling joins the short carriage to the locomotive. Studded roofs, round wheels, and broad body panels give this coloring sheet its main details.

pages.title: LEGO City Race Car Waiting on the Starting Grid Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO City race car waits on the starting grid in this printable coloring page, with a helmeted driver holding the steering wheel beneath a rear wing. A checkered flag stands beside the cockpit. Large tires, visible studs, and angled body panels form the central shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO City Astronaut beside a Rocket on its Launch Pad Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO City astronaut stands beside a rocket in this printable coloring page, raising one hand near a launch pad and tall support gantry. The spacesuit has a planet emblem and chest controls, while the rocket includes circular panels and stabilizing fins. Broad outlines separate the equipment on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO City Passenger Airplane at an Airport Terminal Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO City passenger airplane rests near an airport terminal in this printable coloring page, showing both wings, round engines, landing gear, and a cockpit pilot. A small control tower rises behind the aircraft. Studded surfaces and a row of cabin windows add detail to the broad airplane shapes.

pages.title: LEGO Ninjago Kai Holding a Katana with Flames Around Him Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Ninjago Kai holds a katana in this printable coloring page, standing among flame outlines with a face covering, spiky hair, and a tied waist sash. A fire emblem decorates his uniform. The continuous sword, curved toy hands, and block-shaped boots keep the action clear on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Ninjago Lloyd the Green Ninja Holding his Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Ninjago Lloyd holds his sword in this printable coloring page, wearing a face covering, shoulder guards, and a uniform decorated with a dragon emblem. He stands on a studded baseplate with his other hand lowered. The long blade and broad costume panels define this character coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Ninjago Jay Using Lightning Powers with his Nunchucks Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Ninjago Jay grips chain-linked nunchucks in this printable coloring page, standing beneath lightning bolts with a masked face, wrapped uniform, and tied belt. The two handles connect through large chain loops across his chest. Angular symbols contrast with the rounded hands and boots on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Ninjago Cole Using Earth Powers to Lift Rocks Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Ninjago Cole raises both hands beneath floating rocks in this printable coloring page, wearing a face covering, headband, and mountain-emblem uniform above a studded base. Three large stones hover around his head. Their angular surfaces contrast with the curved sleeves and broad costume sections on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Ninjago Zane Throwing the Shurikens of Ice Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Ninjago Zane throws a shuriken in this printable coloring page, extending one hand while his other arm rests beside a wrapped uniform and tied belt. Large ice crystals rise behind his planted feet. The separate throwing star and clear toy joints emphasize the movement on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Ninjago Nya Controlling a Curling Wave of Water Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Ninjago Nya guides a curling wave in this printable coloring page, holding both hands toward the water while wearing a tied ninja uniform and ponytail. Droplet outlines surround the rising sweep of water. Broad hair sections, curved sleeves, and block-shaped boots form the main character areas on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Ninjago Master Wu Holding his Staff at the Monastery Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Ninjago Master Wu holds his staff in this printable coloring page, standing before monastery steps beneath a conical hat with a long flowing beard. A circular window and curved roof appear behind him. The straight staff, layered robe, and broad beard sections create distinct areas on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Ninjago Lord Garmadon with Four Arms and his Battle Helmet Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Ninjago Lord Garmadon spreads four arms in this printable coloring page, wearing a horned battle helmet, layered chest armor, and a tied waist sash. Each arm ends in a recognizable claw-shaped hand above two block-shaped legs. The symmetrical pose and large helmet sections keep this coloring sheet clearly defined.

pages.title: LEGO Ninjago Golden Dragon Spreading its Wings above a Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO Ninjago Golden Dragon spreads its wings above a temple in this printable coloring page, with a horned head, articulated limbs, and a curling tail. Studded pieces and round joints emphasize its brick-built form. The smaller temple, clouds, and mountain outlines add a setting beneath the dragon.

pages.title: LEGO Star Wars Millennium Falcon Flying through an Asteroid Field Coloring Page
pages.description: The LEGO Millennium Falcon flies among asteroids in this printable coloring page, displaying its circular hull, front mandibles, offset cockpit, and large radar dish. A pilot sits behind the cockpit window, with studs and mounted equipment across the ship. Three separate rock shapes surround the spacecraft on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Batman Holding a Batarang on a Gotham City Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Batman holds a batarang on a rooftop in this printable coloring page, wearing his pointed cowl, bat-emblem suit, utility belt, and flowing cape. The Bat-Signal shines above a skyline of simple buildings. Brickwork and a projecting rooftop ornament provide additional shapes beneath the minifigure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Robin Holding his Staff beside the Bat-Signal Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Robin holds a tall staff beside the Bat-Signal in this printable coloring page, wearing an eye mask, short cape, and a detailed utility belt. His spiky hair and costume emblem distinguish the minifigure. The spotlight's round face and angular support stand add mechanical sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Joker Laughing While Holding a Joker Playing Card Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Joker laughs while holding a playing card in this printable coloring page, wearing a bow tie, buttoned waistcoat, and jacket with a flower decoration. The card carries a simple jester illustration. Swept hair, curved toy hands, and broad trouser panels provide the main shapes on this character coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Hulk Smashing through a Brick Wall Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Hulk smashes through a brick wall in this printable coloring page, thrusting a large fist forward above torn shorts and two broad planted feet. Loose blocks surround the opening behind his muscular toy body. The coloring sheet combines large character areas with smaller studs and broken wall sections.

pages.title: LEGO Captain America Defending Himself with his Round Shield Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Captain America raises his shield defensively in this printable coloring page, wearing a wing-marked helmet and star-emblem uniform while lifting his free hand. Concentric rings surround the shield's central star. Broad armor sections, block-shaped boots, and a few ground details complete this superhero coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Harry Potter Holding his Wand beside Hedwig the Owl Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Harry Potter holds his wand beside Hedwig in this printable coloring page, wearing round glasses, a forehead scar, school robes, and a striped tie. The owl rests on a small perch with folded wings and visible talons. Simple stars and floor tiles surround the pair on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Hermione Granger Casting a Spell beside a Stack of Books Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Hermione Granger casts a spell beside stacked books in this printable coloring page, holding a wand beneath star-shaped sparks while wearing school robes and a tie. Her wavy hair frames a smiling face. Curved toy hands, broad sleeves, and rectangular boots provide distinct areas on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Hogwarts Castle with its Towers Rising above the Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Hogwarts Castle rises above a lake in this printable coloring page, combining pointed towers, conical roofs, arched windows, and a bridge built into the rocky base. Visible studs emphasize the brick construction. Large wall panels and simple water lines balance the smaller architectural details on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Minecraft Creeper Standing beside Grass and Stone Blocks Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO Minecraft Creeper stands beside grass and stone blocks in this printable coloring page, with a studded cube head, tall rectangular body, and short feet. Its familiar face markings appear as enclosed outline shapes. Broad block surfaces and a few grass tufts keep the coloring sheet simple and recognizable.

pages.title: LEGO Minecraft Ender Dragon Circling an End Crystal Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO Minecraft Ender Dragon circles an End crystal tower in this printable coloring page, with angular wings, a square head, articulated legs, and a long curved tail. Studded segments emphasize its brick-built body. The geometric crystal and tall tower provide a separate central structure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Jurassic World T. Rex Roaring beside the Park Gates Coloring Page
pages.description: A LEGO Jurassic World T. rex roars beside the park gates in this printable coloring page, showing pointed teeth, short forearms, strong hind legs, and a curved tail. Flame-topped fixtures flank the entrance behind the dinosaur. Toy joints, body markings, and a few rocks add detail to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Jurassic World Owen Grady Training Blue the Velociraptor Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Owen Grady raises a hand toward Blue in this printable coloring page, standing beside the Velociraptor in a pocketed vest and block-shaped boots. Blue faces him with short forearms, large feet, and a lifted tail. A simple paddock fence and scattered ground shapes frame the interaction on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Movie Emmet Brickowski Wearing the Piece of Resistance at a Construction Site Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Emmet Brickowski wears the Piece of Resistance in this printable coloring page, standing at a construction site with a pocketed work vest and familiar molded hair. The small studded brick is visible behind his shoulder. A crane, traffic cone, and barrier add construction details around the minifigure on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: LEGO Movie Unikitty beside the Cloud Cuckoo Land Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Unikitty stands beside the Cloud Cuckoo Land castle in this printable coloring page, with a unicorn horn, pointed ears, square head, and curling tail. A rainbow arches behind the castle's towers, flag, and doorway. The coloring sheet combines broad character surfaces with simple clouds and decorative building shapes.

pages.title: LEGO Movie Benny Piloting his Spaceship through Space Coloring Page
pages.description: LEGO Benny pilots his spaceship in this printable coloring page, holding two control levers beneath a space helmet and a suit decorated with a planet emblem. Studded wings, large engines, and upright fins frame the open cockpit. Three outlined stars surround the spacecraft on this coloring sheet.
